capabilities: recipe-manager | Stores recipes with ingredients, steps, pictures, categories and tags in a web interface with a REST API, and imports a recipe from the URL of a web page.
meal-planning | Assigns saved recipes to days in a meal plan and builds shopping lists from their ingredients.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Mealie image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Mealie is a self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner: paste the URL of a recipe and Mealie imports its ingredients, steps and picture, or write a recipe in the editor. Recipes are organised with categories, tags and cookbooks, scaled by servings and searched; a meal planner assigns them to days, and shopping lists are built from their ingredients. It serves several users in households, and has a REST API. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database and files, stored in the `mealie` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and, if you wish, set the time zone. Mealie has no setting for the first administrator's password: a new instance starts with Mealie's published default account, shown on its sign-in page, and anyone who reaches the address can use it until you replace it. Open `https://<instance>/` as soon as the instance is ready, sign in, and enter your own email and password in the First Time Setup that follows. Public sign-up is off. You can run one Mealie instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Mealie documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.
